name: com.blackswancausallabs/robins-mcp
title: ROBINS-I V2 MCP
description: ROBINS-I V2 (follow-up cohort studies): assess risk of bias in ONE result of a non-randomized study. Domain and overall judgements are computed by the published algorithms, never asserted by the model; quotes must resolve to the ingested text or are rejected. NOT ROBINS-I V1 — V2 has six domains, not seven.
